subject.title: Feishu plugin WebSocket doesn't receive im.message.receive_v1 events

question: Should maintainers spend live Feishu QA or credentialed diagnostics on this specific WebSocket message-event gap before queueing a code repair?
rationale: The current source path already registers the SDK message handler and starts WebSocket with the dispatcher, but the reported lifecycle-events-still-arrive symptom needs live evidence to identify whether the event is absent before OpenClaw or dropped inside the plugin.

options.title: Run live Feishu diagnostics
options.body: Use a maintainer Feishu app/workspace to capture redacted SDK and gateway logs for lifecycle and `im.message.receive_v1` events on current main before assigning a repair.

options.title: Ask reporter for richer proof
options.body: Request redacted Feishu developer-console event settings and gateway debug logs if maintainer credentials are not available soon.

options.title: Fold into broader inbound-loss triage
options.body: Treat this as a partial overlap with the broader Feishu inbound issue, accepting that its unique lifecycle-event clue may be lost.

recommendation.title: Run live Feishu diagnostics
recommendation.body: Use a maintainer Feishu app/workspace to capture redacted SDK and gateway logs for lifecycle and `im.message.receive_v1` events on current main before assigning a repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history and blame tie this handle to the Feishu monitor and WebSocket handler paths most likely to be inspected first.
